title: permidex GCP roles cache
description: The GCP cache written by `permidex gcp -r`: predefined GCP IAM roles and their permissions.

version.description: Format version. Only version 1 is defined.

fetchedAt.description: When the roles were fetched from the IAM API, in UTC.

name.description: Full role ID, such as roles/compute.admin.

title.description: Human-readable name, such as Compute Admin. Omitted when the API gives none.

description.description: What the role is for. Omitted when the API gives none.

stage.description: Launch stage, such as GA, BETA or ALPHA.

includedPermissions.description: Permissions this role grants, such as compute.instances.get. Omitted when empty.
